INTERCREDITOR AGREEMENT dated as of September 9, 2026, among Red Mesa Capital Bank, as ABL Agent, Ridgeway Finance LLC, as Term Loan Agent, and Copperline Energy Services, Inc., as Borrower.

ARTICLE II LIEN PRIORITIES

SECTION 2.01 Priority of Liens . Notwithstanding the date, time, method, manner or order of grant, attachment or perfection of any Liens, the Liens securing the ABL Obligations on the ABL Priority Collateral shall be senior and prior to the Liens securing the Term Loan Obligations on the ABL Priority Collateral.

ARTICLE IV PAYMENT RESTRICTIONS

SECTION 4.01 Restriction on Payments of Term Loan Obligations . Until the ABL Obligations have been paid in full, the Borrower shall not make any payment of principal of the Term Loan Obligations if, after giving effect thereto, Availability would be less than $15,000,000.
